question: Why does sign letter height scale linearly with viewing distance, and what sets the constant of proportionality?
summary: Derived the Snellen 5-arcmin/letter, 1-arcmin/stroke basis independently from a stroke-count guess, matching optometry standard exactly; predicted the real-world 10-20 ft/inch comfortable-read rule and a separate ~25-50 ft/inch noticeable-distance rule as two distinct regimes before checking corpus, which confirmed both.
